BiblicalUsage: Bachan is a watch-tower, and Isaiah says the pleasant places of the city shall be a place for the watch-tower of the wilderness, where wild asses shall run and flocks shall lie down. A tower for watching, left to the desert when the city falls.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the watch-tower in the desert is the picture of a city that stopped watching, and I mean to keep my own watch.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
